title: Quantum Scaling Demands Advanced Control Electronics
summary: Excessive wiring, heat, and latency are pushing quantum control electronics deeper into cryogenic environments.

title: Smart Telescope Uses Spinning Sensor to Stop Star Trails
summary: DwarfLab's Draco smart telescope uses a physically spinning sensor to cancel out star trails caused by Earth's rotation without an equatorial mount.

title: Frog Skeletal Muscle Powers Swimming Robotic Manta Ray
summary: Scientists used skeletal muscle from a frog leg as a biological actuator to control a tiny robotic manta ray.

title: Stoke Space Raises $1 Billion for Reusable Rockets
summary: Stoke Space secured $1 billion in funding to develop its reusable Nova rockets and targets an early 2027 launch.

title: TANGO Humanoid Navigates Cluttered Spaces Using Vision-Language
summary: TANGO is a new whole-board vision-language-action framework enabling humanoids to navigate cluttered environments through continuous geometry-aware adaptation.

title: DeCAL Model Enhances Dexterous Robotic Manipulation with Tactile Data
summary: DeCAL is a physically grounded vision-language-action model that combines adaptive visuo-tactile fusion and latent co-imagination for contact-rich dexterous manipulation.

title: New Path Loss Models Extend 3GPP Standards Up to 150 GHz
summary: Researchers derived omnidirectional urban microcell path loss models spanning 6.75 to 142 GHz to help extend standardized communications into sub-THz frequencies.

title: Observation-Gated Filtering for Autonomous Mapping
summary: An observation-gated filter improves learned occupancy in autonomous active mapping by suppressing inaccurate predictions without requiring retraining.

title: Efficient Quantile-Resolved Hosting Capacity Assessment
summary: A new computationally efficient method calculates quantile-resolved hosting capacity distributions for low-voltage grids using multivariate normal representations.

title: DYAD Multimodal Dataset for Human Assistance
summary: DYAD is a new synchronized multimodal dataset recording human-human assistance during gearbox assembly to study co-located task intervention.

title: SphereOcc Framework for 3D Scene Understanding
summary: SphereOcc is a new semantic occupancy framework that couples spherical geometry modeling with semantic evidence retrieval for 3D scene understanding.

title: Intelligent Fault Detection for VSC-MTDC Grids
summary: A new algorithm combining S transforms and a residual network with hybrid attention detects faults and lightning in VSC-MTDC grids.

title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning for ICU Alarms
summary: A deep learning framework using SE-ResNets and a Windkessel hemodynamic model reduces false ventricular tachycardia alarms in intensive care units.

title: MPC for Tensegrity Robots via GNN Dynamics
summary: A model predictive path integral controller paired with a contact-aware graph neural network model improves tensegrity robot navigation.

title: Unifying Power Flow and EMT Modeling
summary: A new steady-state framework uses full-physics electromagnetic transient models to achieve high-fidelity grid analysis with significant speedups.

title: Robot Motion as a Physical Communication Channel
summary: Researchers demonstrate a method for robots to transmit short messages through articulate motion detectable by remote sensing without extra hardware.

title: Perception-Aware Humanoid Design Increases Workspace Coverage
summary: A 31-DoF humanoid design with independently actuated cameras increases visible-reachable workspace coverage from 38% to 97%.

title: FRAME: Attribute-Compositional Retrieval for Robot Scene Memory
summary: A new method called FRAME enables language-guided robots to accurately retrieve objects from scene memories using multi-attribute natural language queries.

title: CAST Improves Model-Based Reinforcement Learning in Robotics
summary: CAST uses planner-guided behavior to improve value learning and successfully transfers to a physical quadruped performing a dynamic handstand.

title: FIRE3D Generates Interactive 3D Scenes in Under a Minute
summary: A new framework transforms a single RGB image or casual video into simulation-ready 3D scene assets with decoupled objects in under a minute.

title: Stability Guarantees Established for Asynchronous Model Predictive Control
summary: New theoretical findings establish stability and performance guarantees for asynchronous model predictive control under model mismatch.

title: Real-time Puncture Detection and Recovery for Soft Actuators
summary: A new anomaly detection system uses inertial measurement data to identify punctures and severity in pneumatic soft actuators and maintains actuation force post-failure.

title: XGIMI Unveils 4K/120Hz Ultra-Short-Throw Projector Series
summary: XGIMI previewed its AURA 3 Series, featuring the Aura 3 Max, touted as the world's first 4K/120Hz ultra-short-throw projector series.

title: Creality Presents New 3D Printing and Digital Fabrication Portfolio
summary: Creality introduced new systems spanning filament recycling, resin printing, 3D scanning, laser processing, and digitally manufactured footwear.

title: Dolphin Adopts AI Simulation Tools for Cooling Designs
summary: Dolphin plans to use computational fluid dynamics and thermal simulations across its heavy-duty and industrial product ranges.

title: Pudu D7 Robot Wins IFA Innovation Award
summary: The semi-humanoid Pudu D7 robot has been named an IFA Innovation Awards honoree for its dual-arm manipulation and autonomous battery swapping.

title: Kawasaki and EdgeCortix Partner on AI Defense Systems
summary: Kawasaki and EdgeCortix launched a multi-year program covering technology development, system integration, and prototypes for AI defense systems.

title: 83% of British Cities Highly Vulnerable to Urban Heat
summary: Analysis from Ordnance Survey, the Met Office, and 4 Earth Intelligence reveals that 59 British cities are highly vulnerable to urban heat.

title: Startup Vaire Computing Develops Energy-Recycling Chips
summary: Vaire Computing is building reversible computer chips designed to recycle energy that is normally wasted as heat.

title: Startup Innovates Cheaper and Cleaner Steel Production
summary: A new startup is working on making steel cleaner and cheaper by modernizing the traditional iron ore purification process.
